column6: ANY 2 OR 3S BATTERY WILL WORK. Can't exceed these dimensions:
ANY BRUSHLESS ESC WILL WORK, RC CAR ESC'S HAVE REVERSE AND PLANE ESC'S DO NOT.
IF YOU BUY A DIFFERENT SERVO THAT DOESN'T COME WITH ONE
DO NOT SUBSTITUTE (UNLESS YOU'RE WILLING TO DO MAJOR REDESING)
CAN USE ANY 95A SHORE HARDNESS TPU. Must be hard--Soft TPU will not work.
CAN USE NYLON. DO NOT USE ABS OR PETG
DIGITAL SERVO IS BEST, ANALOG IS SLOW
CAN USE OTHER SHOCKS BUT MUST BE ~80MM
